concepts.name: Action / Karma
concepts.description: Intentional action, work, deed or activity.

concepts.name: Duty / Dharma
concepts.description: Obligation, duty or right action in context.

concepts.name: Svadharma
concepts.description: One's own duty or fitting course of action.

concepts.name: Attachment
concepts.description: Clinging to objects, people, identity or outcomes.

concepts.name: Non-attachment
concepts.description: Acting without clinging to results or objects.

concepts.name: Fruits / Results
concepts.description: Consequences, rewards or fruits of action.

concepts.name: Equanimity / Samatva
concepts.description: Steadiness amid gain/loss, success/failure, pleasure/pain.

concepts.name: Desire / Kama
concepts.description: Craving or desire directed toward an object or outcome.

concepts.name: Anger / Krodha
concepts.description: Anger, wrath or reactive hostility.

concepts.name: Fear
concepts.description: Fear, apprehension or dread.

concepts.name: Grief / Shoka
concepts.description: Sorrow, grief or lamentation.

concepts.name: Suffering / Duhkha
concepts.description: Distress, dissatisfaction or suffering.

concepts.name: Mind / Manas
concepts.description: Mental activity, thought and attention.

concepts.name: Self-control
concepts.description: Regulation of senses, impulses and reactions.

concepts.name: Discipline / Practice
concepts.description: Steady practice, cultivation and restraint.

concepts.name: Meditation / Dhyana
concepts.description: Meditative concentration and contemplative practice.

concepts.name: Knowledge / Jnana
concepts.description: Knowledge or wisdom as taught in the text.

concepts.name: Discernment
concepts.description: Discrimination, clear seeing and wise judgment.

concepts.name: Self-knowledge / Atman
concepts.description: Teaching concerning self, atman, purusha or true nature.

concepts.name: Ego / Doership
concepts.description: Ego, I-making, possessive identity or doership.

concepts.name: Identity / Status
concepts.description: Identification with roles, status, reputation or self-image.

concepts.name: Compassion
concepts.description: Compassion, friendliness, non-harm and concern for beings.

concepts.name: Relationships
concepts.description: Friendship, family, enemies, social bonds and interpersonal conduct.

concepts.name: Pleasure and Pain
concepts.description: Sukha/duhkha and response to pleasant/unpleasant experience.

concepts.name: Gain and Loss
concepts.description: Acquisition/loss and response to changing circumstances.

concepts.name: Success and Failure
concepts.description: Victory/defeat and response to outcomes.

concepts.name: Uncertainty / Doubt
concepts.description: Doubt, uncertainty or lack of clarity.

concepts.name: Decision / Dilemma
concepts.description: Choosing a course of action under conflict or uncertainty.

concepts.name: Purpose / Meaning
concepts.description: Meaning, purpose, goal or direction.

concepts.name: Ambition
concepts.description: Achievement, status seeking or strong goal pursuit.

concepts.name: Mortality / Death
concepts.description: Birth, death, mortality, impermanence and rebirth.

concepts.name: Change / Impermanence
concepts.description: Transient, changing and perishable phenomena.

concepts.name: Faith / Shraddha
concepts.description: Faith, trust or conviction.

concepts.name: Devotion / Bhakti
concepts.description: Devotion, loving worship and relationship with the divine.

concepts.name: Renunciation / Sannyasa
concepts.description: Giving up attachment, egoic ownership or renouncing action/results.

concepts.name: Liberation / Moksha
concepts.description: Freedom from bondage and liberation.

concepts.name: Three Gunas
concepts.description: Sattva, rajas and tamas as modes of prakriti.

concepts.name: Forbearance / Acceptance
concepts.description: Endurance, tolerance and acceptance of unavoidable conditions.

concepts.name: Action vs Outcome
concepts.description: Distinction between what one can act upon and what results.
